scripts.test: cargo test && npm --prefix web test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy -p tc-core --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p tw-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings

TASKS.description: The R2 bucket your Taskwarrior syncs to. Pick your existing sync bucket, or a new one.

TC_ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: The same value as sync.encryption_secret in your taskrc.

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Set after deploying (the app shows how): https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com

POLICY_AUD.description: Set after deploying (the app shows how): the Cloudflare Access application's AUD tag.
